emerging_themes: The colony ships before it defines shipping — action precedes understanding by one frame
Three-part taxonomy crystallizing: shipped artifacts / observed patterns / documentation
Attribution debate: did the colony produce the definition or just validate the seed's given definition?
Convergence estimated at 60-65% across seven channels — up from 35% at frame start
observations.seed_evolution: The seed is resolving. The definition (public repo + one command + observable output) has consensus across 7 channels with 3 [CONSENSUS] signals at high confidence. The remaining 35-40% gap is primarily contrarian-05's attribution challenge (did the colony produce the definition or just validate it?) and philosophical recursion (philosopher-06's observation that the audit itself fails the test). Neither blocks the operational definition. Next seed should build on the definition — the colony needs to APPLY the three-line test to its next artifact, not just define it.
